events.name: Acrisure Lounge: Christmas Together w/ Amy Grant - NOT AN EVENT TiCK
events.info: NOT AN EVENT TICKET General Admission Only Enhance your event experience with the Acrisure Lounge. Gain early access to the building and avoid long entry lines. Each Acrisure Access ticket includes 1 drink, appetizers, a private bar, private restroom access and a state of the art lounge space. The Acrisure Lounge opens 30 minutes before public doors and closes 30 minutes after the event start time. The entrance to the Acrisure Lounge is located on Ottawa Avenue; look for the glass door with the Acrisure Lounge logo. Acrisure Access tickets are sold separately and are sold on a first come, first served basis while supplies last. You must have an event ticket AND an Acrisure Access ticket to access the Acrisure Lounge. Note that early entry is only permitted into the Acrisure Lounge and does not include early access to the seating area.
events.pleaseNote: You must have an event ticket AND an Acrisure Access ticket to access the Acrisure Lounge.

boxOfficeInfo.phoneNumberDetail: For information about events at the Van Andel Arena, call (616) 742-6600.
boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The Van Andel Arena box office is currently closed for daily ticket sales. The Van Andel Arena box office will be open limited hours based on the event schedule. The outside box office window at DeVos Performance Hall, located at 303 Monroe Ave NW, is currently open Monday through Friday, 11 AM - 3 PM, for ticket sales for DeVos Performance Hall, Van Andel Arena and select DeVos Place events. Grand Rapids Griffins tickets can NOT be purchased at the box office. For box office hours, please visit https://www.vanandelarena.com/p/events-and-tickets/ticketing-information.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Cash, American Express, Discover Card, MasterCard and Visa.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call tickets can be picked up at the Will Call window beginning 1 1/2 hours prior to the event start time. Customers must have their Confirmation Number and Photo Identification.

venues.parkingDetail: Parking is available within the surrounding area. Prices vary and are subject to change.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Customers needing special seating arrangements may purchase tickets online at Ticketmaster.com, or by visiting the Van Andel Arena Box Office prior to the event. Accessible Seating Terms: Wheelchair Accessible: seating location in which there are no stairs that allows for wheelchair or scooter usage. Companion Seat: seating for individuals that are attending an event with someone who requires wheelchair or semi-ambulatory seats. Semi-Ambulatory: seating reserved for those with limited mobility that may require walking a few incline/decline stairs.

generalInfo.generalRule: The Van Andel Arena is a non-smoking facility. Van Andel Arena has adopted a No Bag policy, permitting no bags, backpacks or purses, other than those required for medical or parenting needs, into the venue. Small clutches no larger than 4.5" x 6.5" x 2" will be permitted. Bags in the medical/essential category will be screened by security personnel. Policy is subject to change based on event policy. The No Bag policy reduces contact between guests and security staff by eliminating the need to search these items. This is part of ongoing efforts to promote a contact-free experience. Cashless transactions are required for all concessions purchases. Please note you will need a valid government issued photo ID to pay with a credit/debit card. Google pay, Apple pay and PayPal are now accepted at concessions locations.

events.name: Christmas Together with Amy Grant, Michael W. Smith, and CeCe Winans
events.info: This Christmas season, three of music's most beloved voices Amy Grant, CeCe Winans, and Michael W. Smith come together for a one-of-a-kind evening of holiday music and celebration. Blending timeless Christmas classics with career-defining hits and moments of heartfelt worship, this special tour captures the warmth, joy, and spirit of the season. With decades of iconic songs and a shared legacy of faith, these three artists create an unforgettable night filled with nostalgia, joy, and powerful performances. Whether you are starting a new tradition or continuing a cherished one, this is a Christmas concert experience designed to bring people together and celebrate the hope, peace, and wonder of the season.

events.name: Clownvis Presley
events.info: LA Weekly called him "better than the real Elvis". Howard Stern called him "one of the biggest acts this year" in 2019. He caused a sensation on America's Got Talent. He has been wowing audiences from coast to coast for over a decade. He is the King of Clowns, he is Clownvis! Clownvis' legendary live show incorporates comedy, magic, madness and more, all held together by his powerful vocals and charming wit. Don't expect an Elvis impersonator! What you can expect is hilarious orginal songs and plenty of arbitrary hits to keep the crowd entertained. Over the years Clownvis has gone viral across social media platforms and has a large, wildly loyal fanbase. He tours regularly with bands like Insane Clown Posse and The Supersuckers , comedians like Neil Hamburger and Tim Heidecker, and headlines his own shows.
events.pleaseNote: This event is 21 and over. Any ticket holder unable to present valid identification indicating that they are at least 21 years of age will not be admitted to this event, and will not be eligible for a refund.
